contentText:
Gift-giving isn't just about grabbing something solid under a determined spending limit. It's an expression of love, a way to show someone how well you really know them. That doesn't mean you have to do it all on your own, though. Sometimes you just need a push in the right direction to get things rolling.

This year, we spent hours collecting our favorites to help you get ahead of your holiday shopping. This list has everything: minimalist smart rings , Play-Doh flowers , sleek beat machines - you name it. Whatever your needs, no matter how demanding the recipient, you'll find something exceptional below for that special someone on your li …
